lines.en: I walk over using your gait.
I copy the way you step.

lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，隔了一点。
lines.en: I follow a little behind you.
I walk steadily, like a person.

lines.zh: 我朝你挥手，动作很自然。
lines.en: I wave at you, quite naturally.

lines.zh: 我绕到你身边，走在同一条线。
lines.en: I come to your side and share your line.
I round the corner without changing posture.
I lower my voice to copy yours.

lines.zh: 我走两步就停下来等你。
lines.en: Two steps, then I wait for you.
I walk backwards, facing you.
I trail you along the wall.
I stand in the same posture as you.
My face moves, as if adjusting.

lines.zh: 我学你把手插在口袋里。
lines.en: I copy you with hands in pockets.
I'm trying out your voice.
I remember what you just said.
My movements lag half a beat.
I tilt my head at your exact angle.
I haven't moved; you're the one hesitating.

lines.zh: 我把肩放松，装得很随意。
lines.en: I drop my shoulders to look casual.
I practice your smile.
There are frayed edges on my shadow.

lines.zh: 我抬手摸脸，摸到的不是你。
lines.en: I touch my face and it isn't yours.
I check myself in the water.

lines.zh: 我把手举起来，比了比高度。
lines.en: I raise a hand, comparing heights.
Do I look like a mirror to you?
We're dressed the same.
Say a line and I'll repeat it.
Would your friends tell us apart?

lines.zh: 我笑的时候，牙齿不太对。
lines.en: When I smile, the teeth are off.
You back away; I copy that too.
I raise a hand; no need to tense.

lines.zh: 你手上也有这道伤，对吧？
lines.en: You have that scar on your hand too, don't you?
Standing together, we're very alike.
Don't shout; no one would believe it.
I know your name.
I sound more like you than you do.

lines.zh: 你看我的眼睛，那里不对。
lines.en: Look at my eyes; something's wrong there.

lines.zh: 我用你的脸，站到你面前。
lines.en: I wear your face and stand before you.
Your shadow leans this way.
I copy your hands on your hips.
Would you like to see my face?
I remember your family.
I pull my hat a little lower.

lines.zh: 我的脸歪了一下，很快正回。
lines.en: My face slips, then fixes.
I step back, my movements stiff.
That showed a flaw.
I press the wound, as you would.
My voice cracked.
I don't cry out; that would spoil it.
I straighten and pretend it's nothing.
My edges are a bit frayed.
I lower my head to hide my face.
I still have to keep it up.
The moment you turn, I follow.
The further you go, the better.
I've kept what you said.
Your voice is useful.
Try shouting once more.
I want to try your name.
Lend me what's in your hand.
You've walked somewhere empty.
Do you trust me yet?
We collide, like a mirror.
You touch me; my hand is cold.

lines.zh: 我的肩撞在你肩上，一样高。
lines.en: My shoulder meets yours, same height.
I step back with your own step.

lines.zh: 你抓住我的领子，我笑了。
lines.en: You grab my collar, and I smile.
I press close and copy your breathing.
We crowd together; hard to tell apart.
You push me; I push back.

lines.zh: 我的帽子掉了，露出一点。
lines.en: My hat falls, revealing a little.

lines.zh: 另一个也穿着你的衣服。
lines.en: Another wears your clothes too.

lines.zh: 她学你的动作，比我还像。
lines.en: She copies you better than I do.
We stand together like a pair.
She straightens my hat.
We traded voices.
She remembers more about you.

lines.zh: 我们不需要说话，都是一样的。
lines.en: We needn't speak; we're the same.
Two identical figures.
She moves first, I follow, the same.
We walk through that door together.

lines.zh: 我捡起你掉的东西，收好。
lines.en: I pick up what you dropped and keep it.
I put your hat on.

lines.zh: 我把你的刀捡起来，握法相同。
lines.en: I pick up your knife with the same grip.
I pick up your letter and read it.
I turn the mirror over.

lines.zh: 我把你的手套套上，正好。
lines.en: I put on your gloves; they fit.
I pick up your key and keep it.

lines.zh: 我把地上的东西放进你的包里。
lines.en: I put the fallen things into your bag.
I pick up one of your buttons.
I put on your cloak.
I've taken a liking to that face.
You're alone; good.
I've started copying.
You've turned away.
You've gone far enough.
No one comes here.
I've kept your voice.
Who are you calling for?

lines.zh: 我把你的名字说了一遍。
lines.en: I said your name once.
What I want is everything you're wearing.
I've chosen this look of yours.
I walk toward you, naturally.
Don't run; it spoils the likeness.
Only a few paces between us.

lines.zh: 你听，我的声音和你一样。
lines.en: Hear that? My voice matches yours.
I'm in no hurry; the time isn't yet.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，保持这个距离。
lines.en: I follow at this distance.

lines.zh: 你回头看到的是你自己。
lines.en: You turn and see yourself.
I copy the angle of your hand.
I know all your steps.

lines.zh: 我在等你走到没有人的地方。
lines.en: I wait for you to reach somewhere empty.
Your friends won't suspect me.

lines.zh: 我把声音压低，跟你一样。
lines.en: I lower my voice just like yours.

lines.zh: 你停下来，我便不再靠近。
lines.en: You stop, so I stop closing in.
You count the way home.
I've been down that road already.

lines.zh: 你的影子在旁边，我的也在。
lines.en: Your shadow's there, and mine as well.
You've started looking back.

lines.zh: 我让开半步，不让你看清。
lines.en: I give half a step so you can't see clear.
You're walking faster.
I copy your faster walk.
I'll open that door ahead.
You're weighing whether to shout.
If you shout, I'll shout too.
Ten more steps is enough.
I strike using your own technique.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕，力气相同。
lines.en: I grip your wrist with equal strength.

lines.zh: 我推你一把，你自己退的。
lines.en: I push once; you did the retreating.
I raise my elbow the way you do.
I haul on your cloak.

lines.zh: 你挡得住，但分不清谁是谁。
lines.en: You can block, but you can't tell which is which.
I call you by your own name.
I take your hand and press it down.
You back off; I smile and step back.
I mimic how you take a hit.
That broke my pose.
I grip your shoulder hard.
I shake my head like you do.
I use your blade with your grip.

lines.zh: 你回头看，我就在你身后。
lines.en: You look back, and I'm behind you.

lines.zh: 我站在你刚才走过的地方。
lines.en: I stand where you just walked.
These clothes were copied.

lines.zh: 我先学会走路，再学会说话。
lines.en: First I learned to walk, then to speak.

lines.zh: 你的邻居刚才看见我了。
lines.en: Your neighbour saw me just now.

lines.zh: 我从门里出来，像往常一样。
lines.en: I come out the door, as usual.
I checked the mirror; satisfied.
My face still needs work.
Everyone here knows you.
I'll wait at the crossing first.
My voice comes out a little raw.

lines.zh: 我照着你的影子调整自己。
lines.en: I adjust myself to your shadow.
I walk slowly, as if learning.

lines.zh: 我先学你的步子，再看你的脸。
lines.en: First I learn your walk, then your face.

lines.zh: 我在这条路上走过两遍。
lines.en: I've walked this road twice.

lines.zh: 我抬头，找那个熟悉的身影。
lines.en: I look up for that familiar figure.

lines.zh: 我从人群里走出来，很自然。
lines.en: I step out of the crowd, naturally.
My name is borrowed too.
I stand at the door and knock twice.
I've already got your voice.
I smooth my clothes.

lines.zh: 火烧到我，皮肤卷了一点。
lines.en: Fire catches me, and my skin curls.
I fall, and the whole pose comes apart.

lines.zh: 水把我泡开，像纸一样软。
lines.en: Water soaks me soft as paper.

lines.zh: 轰的一声，我的形状被冲散。
lines.en: A boom, and my shape is blasted apart.

lines.zh: 箭钉进来，露出里面的空。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in and shows the hollow inside.
A light burns away my disguise.

lines.zh: 雷光一亮，我的脸全露了。
lines.en: Lightning flashes, and my face is bare.
There's no one here to copy.
